thread:
Maya: Quick sync — planning a staged rollout for the new "dedicated/private mix" routing + shadow routing feature. Proposal: opt-in canary (1% tenants) -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks with shadow traffic to Dedicated for comparison. Need ops/pm/eng sign-off on gates and runbook.

Sam: sounds good. what are the concrete success gates at each step? latency, error rate, cost drift?

Maya: yes — propose gates:
- latency p95 <= baseline + 30ms
- error rate (5xx) <= baseline + 0.05%
- avg cost per token increase <= 10%
- eval quality regression (prompt set A) no drop >1% exact match

Leila: oncall + SRE ask: need explicit kill-switch per-tenant and a global emergency rollback that doesn't require code change. Also want a throttled fallback to host model variants rather than full cutover.

AJ: Agree. Traffic plan: slice by tenant priority: P0 (sales) 0% canary unless opted in; P1 1% -> 10%; P2 default ramp. We'll keep a rolling window of 15m for metrics.

Kim: Enterprise customers will request opt-out and legal may need a config knob for private-only routing. Add a column in the tenant CSV for 'routing_mode: private-only | mixed | hosted-only'.

Sam: For telemetry, we need per-request tags: feature_flag=dpmix, canary_cohort, routed_target, shadow_sample. Also store sampled payload diffs for 1% of requests.

Maya: good call. Add to rollout checklist:
1) feature flag enabled (ff-dpmix)
2) telemetry tags
3) runbook doc w/ rollback steps
4) tenant opt-in CSV updated
5) two-day blackout window for customer-critical accounts

Leila: Runbook snippet for emergency rollback:
```
# kill switch
curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/flags/ff-dpmix/off" -H "Auth: $TOKEN"
# fallback route
POST /routing/policies/apply { "policy": "force-hosted" }
```
If the flag API fails we need a manual route change documented with exact links to the routing console.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC -> 06:00 UTC. Auto-monitoring hooks enabled (:eyes:)

AJ: A/B test dimension: run shadow compare of responses for a sampled prompt set (1000 requests/day) and compute semantic similarity and hallucination rate. If similarity < 0.92 or hallucination delta > 0.5% at any gate -> pause ramp.

Maya: who owns the similarity eval? Research or Eng-ML?

Sam: Eng-ML for the initial harness, product will own pass/fail thresholds. We'll instrument a dashboard with alerts.

Kim: Also add a customer communication plan: notify customers in P0/P1 72h before their routing changes, include opt-out steps.

Leila: Ops checklist: confirm rollback play tested in staging (at 3am local), runbook dry-run with oncall, verify alerting thresholds, confirm KMS access for private keys.

Maya: ok action items:
- Sam: implement telemetry tags + dashboard (ETA 4 days)
- AJ: update traffic slice rules and tenant CSV (ETA 2 days)
- Leila: draft runbook + test rollback in staging (ETA 3 days)
- Kim: customer comms draft (ETA 3 days)
- Eng-ML: similarity harness + eval thresholds (ETA 5 days)

Sam: I'll post a short PR with the ff config. link: https://git.redwood/infra/ff/PR-221

Maya: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after dry-run. :thumbsup:
